description: This file defines the SyntaxErrorException class within the JmesPath namespace. It represents syntax errors encountered during parsing and provides detailed error messages including the position and expected tokens.

classes.name: SyntaxErrorException
classes.description: An exception class that signals syntax errors with context in JmesPath expressions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the SyntaxErrorException with a detailed message including position, expression, and expectations.

methods.name: createTokenMessage
methods.description: Creates a detailed message about expected tokens and the found token.
